reviews.comment: The honors class is new, and honestly it really sucks, but she is a great person and professor. She's super caring, pretty chill, and even though I'm dropping out of the honors program I'm glad I got her for a professor.

Dr. Korzow is a phenomenal human being and cares very deeply about her students, there's no doubt about that. The main grievance most people have with her class is that she was extremely late returning grades and sometimes went on tangents in lectures. Take the class for a very, very easy A and for some cool archaeology facts.

I love Dr. Richter!!! I had absolutely no experience with archaeology coming into the class, but she made it interesting and enjoyable. Easy easy A, extremely understanding and kind-hearted woman. There's no homework aside from 5 labs, she only gives a midterm and final with weekly quizzes where she drops the lowest grade. Would totally recommend!

She was very inclusive in discussions and always gave feedback on class responses, even if they weren't exactly correct. She made sure her students felt heard and grading criteria is easy to meet! Definitely a class and professor worth taking.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Richter understood that a lot of students were taking her class for a core credit. Quizzes and exams were straight from the book besides the essay(s) on the exams, which she provides the prompts for in advance. Attendance point system is very lenient. Labs are harder and she does grade tougher on them but put in effort and you should be fine.

This professor is honestly terrible. The tests are way too easy for a college class, like high school-level easy. She spends so much time answering every single student question in class that we barely cover the material we're supposed to. She tries way too hard to be friendly, but it just comes off as annoying. The whole class is a waste of time.

Dr. Richter is AWESOME! Her lectures are great and very entertaining, it doesn't feel like a lecture to me but rather a podcast. The quizzes and tests are easy, the labs are a little tougher. She gives you so many opportunities to get a good grade so the focus is on learning not just grades which is amazing. Best prof i've had, TAKE THE CLASS

One of the first things she told us was that she is not an archaeologist so I don't know why she is teaching this class? The lectures were good, but sometimes we spent the whole time answering student questions which was not helpful. Quizzes and projects are ok and manageable. Easy A if you want an easy class with very little actual work.
